original_english: Reproduction is a biological process by which living beings produce new individuals of their own kind.
hinglish_roman: Reproduction ek biological process hai jiske zariye living beings apni hi tarah ke naye individuals paida karte hain.

original_english: Every organism has a definite life span - it is born, grows, matures, reproduces and eventually dies.
hinglish_roman: Har organism ki ek definite life span hoti hai - woh janam leta hai, badhta hai, mature hota hai, reproduce karta hai aur aakhir mein mar jaata hai.

original_english: Living beings reproduce in two main ways - asexually, where a single parent produces offspring that are almost exact copies of the parent, and sexually, where offspring inherit a mix of characteristics from the two individuals.
hinglish_roman: Living beings do tareekon se reproduce karte hain - asexually, jahan ek single parent aisa offspring produce karta hai jo almost parent ki exact copy hota hai, aur sexually, jahan offspring ko dono individuals ki mixed characteristics milti hain.

original_english: Asexual mode of reproduction is seen in many unicellular organisms like bacteria, amoeba, yeast and simple multicellular organisms like hydra and sponge.
hinglish_roman: Asexual reproduction bahut saare unicellular organisms mein dekha jaata hai jaise bacteria, amoeba, yeast aur simple multicellular organisms jaise hydra aur sponge mein.

original_english: Vegetative propagation means that new plants arise from the vegetative parts, that is, from the growing parts of a plant.
hinglish_roman: Vegetative propagation ka matlab hai ki naye plants, plant ke vegetative parts yaani growing parts se nikalte hain.

original_english: Potato and ginger have fleshy underground stems that sprout new plants without producing seeds.
hinglish_roman: Aalu aur adrak ke fleshy underground stems hote hain jo bina seeds produce kiye naye plants uga dete hain.

original_english: Bryophyllum leaves sprout tiny plantlets which eventually grow into new plants.
hinglish_roman: Bryophyllum ke patte chote-chote plantlets ugaate hain jo aakhirkar naye plants ban jaate hain.

original_english: Grafting involves inserting a stem cutting of one plant into a slit made on the rooted plant of another variety.
hinglish_roman: Grafting mein ek plant ki stem cutting ko doosri variety ke rooted plant ke slit mein fit kiya jaata hai.

original_english: In layering, a flexible twig is buried under the soil and after roots develop, it is cut from the parent plant to grow independently.
hinglish_roman: Layering mein ek flexible twig ko mitti ke neeche dabaaya jaata hai aur roots develop hone ke baad, use parent plant se kaat diya jaata hai taaki woh alag grow kar sake.

original_english: Tissue culture technique has revolutionised farming practices like banana farming by providing mass-produced healthy plantlets.
hinglish_roman: Tissue culture technique ne banana farming jaisi farming practices mein revolution la diya hai kyunki isme mass-produced healthy plantlets milte hain.

original_english: In organisms like hydra, repeated cell division at a specific site on the parent body produces a small outgrowth called a bud.
hinglish_roman: Hydra jaise organisms mein, parent body ke ek specific jagah par baar baar cell division hone se ek chhoti si outgrowth banti hai jise bud kehte hain.

original_english: The bud enlarges and separates from the parent to live independently - this process is called budding.
hinglish_roman: Bud bada hota hai aur parent se alag hokar independently jeena shuru karta hai - is process ko budding kehte hain.

original_english: Spores are lightweight, usually single-celled structures that float easily through air currents and germinate quickly into a new individual when moisture and nutrients are available.
hinglish_roman: Spores halke aur aksar single-celled hote hain jo aasaani se hawa ke saath ud jaate hain aur jab naami aur nutrients milein toh jaldi se naye individual mein germinate ho jaate hain.

original_english: In asexual reproduction, the central process is mitosis, a type of cell division that produces two daughter cells each having the same number of chromosomes as the parent cell.
hinglish_roman: Asexual reproduction mein central process mitosis hai, yeh ek aisa cell division hai jisme do daughter cells banti hain jinmein parent cell jitne hi chromosomes hote hain.

original_english: Offspring produced by asexual reproduction are genetically identical to the parent and are called clones.
hinglish_roman: Asexual reproduction se paida hone waale offspring parent ke genetically identical hote hain aur inhe clones kaha jaata hai.

original_english: Sexual reproduction involves two parents in the formation of a new individual, meaning both parents contribute to the genetic material of the offspring.
hinglish_roman: Sexual reproduction mein do parents milkar ek naya individual banate hain, yaani dono parents offspring ke genetic material mein contribute karte hain.

original_english: Meiosis is a special type of cell division that reduces the chromosome number of a parent cell from diploid to haploid in daughter cells.
hinglish_roman: Meiosis ek special type ka cell division hai jisme parent cell ke chromosomes ki sankhya diploid se haploid ho jaati hai daughter cells mein.

original_english: Humans have 23 pairs of chromosomes, which means a total of 46 chromosomes in each body cell.
hinglish_roman: Insaanon mein 23 pairs of chromosomes hote hain, matlab har body cell mein kul 46 chromosomes hote hain.

original_english: In plants, the pollen grain contains male gametes and delivers them to an ovule which contains the female gamete or egg.
hinglish_roman: Plants mein, pollen grain mein male gametes hote hain jo inhe ovule tak pohonchate hain jahan female gamete yaani egg hota hai.

original_english: Flowers serve as reproductive organs in angiosperms, which are the most diverse group of plants on Earth.
hinglish_roman: Angiosperms mein flowers reproductive organs ki tarah kaam karte hain, aur angiosperms dharti par plants ka sabse diverse group hai.

original_english: A complete flower has four parts - sepals, petals, stamens and pistil.
hinglish_roman: Ek complete flower mein chaar parts hote hain - sepals, petals, stamens aur pistil.

original_english: The stamen is the male part of a flower and consists of a filament and an anther which produces pollen grains containing male gametes.
hinglish_roman: Stamen phool ka male part hota hai aur isme ek filament aur ek anther hota hai jo male gametes wale pollen grains produce karta hai.

original_english: The pistil is the female part of the flower and has three subparts - stigma, style and ovary.
hinglish_roman: Pistil phool ka female part hota hai aur iske teen subparts hote hain - stigma, style aur ovary.

original_english: The stigma is located at the tip of the pistil and may be flat and/or sticky to receive pollen.
hinglish_roman: Stigma pistil ki tip par hota hai aur yeh flat aur/ya sticky ho sakta hai taaki pollen ko pakad sake.

original_english: The transfer of pollen grains from the anther to the stigma of a flower is called pollination.
hinglish_roman: Anther se pollen grains ka stigma tak transfer hona pollination kehlata hai.

original_english: Self-pollination is when pollen transfers to the stigma of the same flower or another flower of the same plant.
hinglish_roman: Self-pollination tab hoti hai jab pollen usi phool ke ya usi plant ke doosre phool ke stigma par transfer hota hai.

original_english: Cross-pollination happens when pollen is transferred from a flower of one plant to the stigma of a flower of another plant of the same type.
hinglish_roman: Cross-pollination tab hoti hai jab pollen ek plant ke phool se doosre same type ke plant ke phool ke stigma par jaata hai.

original_english: Pollination by wind is seen in plants like wheat, maize and rice, where pollen grains are light and small and produced in large numbers.
hinglish_roman: Wheat, maize aur rice jaise plants mein wind se pollination hoti hai, jahan pollen grains halke aur chote hote hain aur badi matra mein produce hote hain.

original_english: Insect-pollinated flowers like sunflower and hibiscus are often brightly coloured, produce nectar and give off fragrance to attract pollinators.
hinglish_roman: Sunflower aur hibiscus jaise insect-pollinated flowers aksar chamkeelay rang ke hote hain, nectar produce karte hain aur pollinators ko attract karne ke liye khushbu dete hain.

original_english: Once pollen reaches a compatible stigma, pollen grains produce pollen tubes that grow down through the style into the ovary.
hinglish_roman: Jab pollen compatible stigma tak pahunch jaata hai, pollen grains pollen tubes banate hain jo style ke zariye ovary mein neeche ki taraf badhti hain.

original_english: The male gamete moves through the pollen tube and arrives at the ovule where it fuses with the egg cell - this fusion is called fertilisation.
hinglish_roman: Male gamete pollen tube se hokar ovule tak pahunchta hai jahan woh egg cell se fuse hota hai - is fusion ko fertilisation kehte hain.

original_english: The fertilised egg is called a zygote, which later develops into an embryo, while the ovary develops into a fruit and ovules develop into seeds.
hinglish_roman: Fertilised egg ko zygote kehte hain jo baad mein embryo ban jaata hai, jabki ovary fruit ban jaati hai aur ovules seeds ban jaate hain.

original_english: Seed dispersal takes place by wind, water or animals, and when conditions like water, air and temperature are favourable, the seed germinates and grows into a new plant.
hinglish_roman: Seeds ka dispersal hawa, paani ya jaanwaron ke zariye hota hai, aur jab paani, hawa aur temperature jaisi conditions suitable hon, toh seed germinate hokar naya plant ban jaata hai.

original_english: In many aquatic animals like frogs and most fish, fertilisation occurs outside the body and is called external fertilisation.
hinglish_roman: Bahut saare aquatic animals jaise mendak aur zyada tar machhliyon mein fertilisation body ke bahar hoti hai aur ise external fertilisation kehte hain.

original_english: In reptiles, birds and mammals, fertilisation takes place inside the body of the female and is called internal fertilisation.
hinglish_roman: Reptiles, birds aur mammals mein fertilisation female ke body ke andar hoti hai aur ise internal fertilisation kehte hain.

original_english: Fish and amphibians produce several hundred to several thousand eggs at a time with yolk, which contains nutritive substances to nourish the developing embryos.
hinglish_roman: Machhliyan aur amphibians ek baar mein kai sau se kai hazaar andey deti hain jinmein yolk hota hai jo develop ho rahe embryos ko poshan deta hai.

original_english: A larva is an intermediate feeding stage in the life cycle of some organisms like butterflies and frogs.
hinglish_roman: Larva titliyon aur mendakon jaise organisms ke life cycle mein ek intermediate feeding stage hota hai.

original_english: The male reproductive system has organs that produce sperm and help them transfer to the female body.
hinglish_roman: Male reproductive system mein aise organs hote hain jo sperm produce karte hain aur unhe female body tak pahunchane mein madad karte hain.

original_english: Sperm are produced in two oval-shaped organs called testes, present in a pouch of skin called the scrotum.
hinglish_roman: Sperm do oval-shaped organs mein bante hain jise testes kehte hain, yeh scrotum naam ki ek skin ki theli mein hote hain.

original_english: The scrotum keeps the testes slightly cooler than normal body temperature, which is necessary for sperm formation.
hinglish_roman: Scrotum testes ko normal body temperature se thoda thanda rakhta hai jo sperm banane ke liye zaroori hai.

original_english: Glands like the seminal vesicles and the prostate add fluids to nourish the sperm and help them remain active and move.
hinglish_roman: Seminal vesicles aur prostate jaise glands sperm ko nourish karne wale fluids add karte hain aur unhe active aur motile rehne mein madad karte hain.

original_english: Each sperm has a head containing genetic material and a long tail that helps it swim towards the egg.
hinglish_roman: Har sperm mein ek head hota hai jisme genetic material hota hai aur ek lamba tail hota hai jo use egg ki taraf swim karne mein madad karta hai.

original_english: The female reproductive system has a pair of ovaries, oviducts or fallopian tubes, a uterus and a vagina.
hinglish_roman: Female reproductive system mein ek pair of ovaries, oviducts yaani fallopian tubes, ek uterus aur ek vagina hota hai.

original_english: The uterus is a bag-like structure where a foetus develops, and it opens into the vagina through a narrow passage called the cervix.
hinglish_roman: Uterus ek theli jaisi structure hoti hai jahan foetus develop hota hai, aur yeh cervix naam ki ek tangi passage ke zariye vagina mein khulta hai.

original_english: The process of the formation of gametes is called gametogenesis and it takes place in the testes and the ovaries.
hinglish_roman: Gametes ke banne ki process ko gametogenesis kehte hain aur yeh testes aur ovaries mein hoti hai.

original_english: In humans, cells have 46 chromosomes but sperm and eggs have only 23 so that when they combine, the zygote has the same number as the parents.
hinglish_roman: Insaanon mein normal cells mein 46 chromosomes hote hain lekin sperm aur eggs mein sirf 23 hote hain taaki jab woh milein toh zygote mein parents jitne chromosomes ho jaayein.

original_english: From puberty onwards, usually one mature egg is released every month from one of the ovaries - this is called ovulation.
hinglish_roman: Puberty ke baad se, aam taur par har mahine ek ovary se ek mature egg release hota hai - ise ovulation kehte hain.

original_english: If a sperm encounters an egg and fuses with it, a zygote is formed and the inner lining of the uterus becomes thicker and richer in blood vessels.
hinglish_roman: Agar sperm egg se milta hai aur usse fuse ho jaata hai toh zygote ban jaata hai aur uterus ki inner lining zyada moti aur blood vessels se bhari ho jaati hai.

original_english: If an egg is not fertilised, it degenerates and the inner lining of the uterus sheds - this process is called menstruation or a period.
hinglish_roman: Agar egg fertilise nahi hota, toh woh khatam ho jaata hai aur uterus ki inner lining girne lagti hai - is process ko menstruation ya period kehte hain.

original_english: The menstrual cycle repeats typically every 21 to 35 days and usually begins at puberty, between the ages of 10 to 14 in girls, and continues until menopause around age 50.
hinglish_roman: Menstrual cycle aam taur par har 21 se 35 din mein repeat hota hai aur puberty ke waqt shuru hota hai jo ladkiyon mein usually 10 se 14 saal ki umar mein hoti hai, aur lagbhag 50 saal ki umar mein menopause tak chalta hai.

original_english: Pregnancy in humans lasts about nine months and is divided into three stages called trimesters.
hinglish_roman: Insaanon mein pregnancy lagbhag nau mahine tak chalti hai aur ise teen stages mein baanta jaata hai jinhe trimesters kehte hain.

original_english: In the first trimester, the fertilised egg develops into an embryo during the first two months and major organs start forming.
hinglish_roman: Pehle trimester mein, pehle do mahino mein fertilised egg embryo ban jaata hai aur major organs banne shuru ho jaate hain.

original_english: From about the ninth week, the developing embryo is called a foetus, which continues to grow and develop through the second and third trimesters.
hinglish_roman: Lagbhag nauwein hafte se, develop ho rahe embryo ko foetus kaha jaata hai jo doosre aur teesre trimester mein barhna aur develop hona jaari rakhta hai.

original_english: During childbirth, strong contractions of the muscles of the uterus help push the foetus out through the birth canal.
hinglish_roman: Prasav ke waqt uterus ki muscles ki tej contractions foetus ko birth canal se bahar dhakelte hain.

original_english: Breastfeeding is essential because a mother's milk provides complete nutrition and protects the infant from many diseases.
hinglish_roman: Breastfeeding bahut zaroori hai kyunki maa ka doodh poori nutrition deta hai aur bacche ko kai bimariyon se bachata hai.

original_english: Sexually Transmitted Infections or STIs include gonorrhoea, herpes, syphilis, genital warts and HIV, which can eventually lead to AIDS.
hinglish_roman: Sexually Transmitted Infections yaani STIs mein gonorrhoea, herpes, syphilis, genital warts aur HIV shamil hain jo aakhirkar AIDS ka kaaran ban sakta hai.

original_english: Using condoms can prevent the transmission of STIs and also help prevent pregnancy.
hinglish_roman: Condom use karne se STIs ka transmission roka ja sakta hai aur yeh pregnancy rokne mein bhi madad karta hai.

original_english: Oral contraceptive pills change the release of eggs by altering hormones, though these may have some side effects.
hinglish_roman: Oral contraceptive pills hormones ko alter karke egg ka release badal deti hain, lekin inke kuch side effects bhi ho sakte hain.

original_english: Intra-Uterine Devices such as Copper-T are placed in the uterus to avoid pregnancy.
hinglish_roman: Copper-T jaise Intra-Uterine Devices ko uterus ke andar rakha jaata hai taaki pregnancy na ho.

original_english: Surgical methods to prevent pregnancy include blocking the vas deferens in males or the fallopian tubes in females.
hinglish_roman: Pregnancy rokne ke surgical methods mein males mein vas deferens aur females mein fallopian tubes ko band karna shamil hai.

original_english: Prenatal sex determination is strictly prohibited by law in India to maintain sex ratio for a healthy society.
hinglish_roman: Prasav se pehle ling nirdharan karna India mein kanoon dwara sakht roop se mana hai taaki samaj mein ling anupaat theek rahe.

original_english: Variation helps some individuals adapt better to changing environments and over time, this process contributes to evolution.
hinglish_roman: Variation kuch individuals ko badlte environments mein behtar adapt karne mein madad karta hai aur yeh process samay ke saath evolution mein contribute karta hai.

original_english: Louis Pasteur proved that new life always comes from pre-existing life and established the germ theory of disease.
hinglish_roman: Louis Pasteur ne prove kiya ki nayi zindagi hamesha pehle se maujood zindagi se aati hai aur unhone germ theory of disease establish ki.

original_english: P. Maheshwari was known as the Father of Indian Embryology and developed the technique of in-vitro fertilisation in flowering plants.
hinglish_roman: P. Maheshwari ko Father of Indian Embryology ke naam se jaana jaata tha aur unhone flowering plants mein in-vitro fertilisation ki technique develop ki.

original_english: In-vitro Fertilisation or IVF is a medical technique in which an egg and a sperm are combined outside the female body in a laboratory dish.
hinglish_roman: In-vitro Fertilisation yaani IVF ek medical technique hai jisme egg aur sperm ko female body ke bahar ek laboratory dish mein combine kiya jaata hai.

original_english: Females have XX sex chromosomes while males have XY chromosomes; the father determines the biological sex of the baby.
hinglish_roman: Females mein XX sex chromosomes hote hain jabki males mein XY hote hain; bacha ka biological sex baap determine karta hai.

original_english: More than 10 lakh ASHA workers are trained community health workers who promote hygiene, immunisation and family planning across India.
hinglish_roman: 10 lakh se zyada ASHA workers trained community health workers hain jo poore India mein hygiene, immunisation aur family planning ko promote karti hain.

original_english: Selective breeding involves farmers choosing plants with desirable characters for reproduction to develop improved crop varieties.
hinglish_roman: Selective breeding mein kisan aise plants ko reproduce karne ke liye choose karte hain jinmein desirable characters hote hain taaki improved crop varieties tayaar ho sakein.

original_english: Asexual reproduction is fast and helps organisms increase their population quickly, especially when environmental conditions are favourable.
hinglish_roman: Asexual reproduction tezi se hoti hai aur organisms ko apni population jaldi badhane mein madad karta hai, khaaskar jab environmental conditions theek hon.

original_english: Fungi grow very fast by spore formation and degrade organic wastes, pollutants and even heavy metals from industrial waste.
hinglish_roman: Fungi spore formation ke zariye bahut tezi se badhte hain aur organic wastes, pollutants aur yahan tak ki industrial waste ke heavy metals ko bhi degrade kar dete hain.

original_english: Penicillin and amoxicillin are antibiotics derived from fungi that have saved countless lives from bacterial infections.
hinglish_roman: Penicillin aur amoxicillin fungi se milne wale antibiotics hain jo bacterial infections se anginat logon ki jaan bacha chuke hain.

original_english: A woman's health during pregnancy plays a vital role in the baby's growth, so she should eat a balanced diet rich in proteins, vitamins and minerals.
hinglish_roman: Pregnancy mein aurat ki sehat bacha ke vikas mein ek important role nibhati hai, isliye use proteins, vitamins aur minerals se bharpur balanced diet lena chahiye.

original_english: Post-partum depression is a recognised condition of anxiety and fatigue experienced by some mothers after delivery.
hinglish_roman: Post-partum depression ek recognised condition hai jisme kuch maaon ko delivery ke baad anxiety aur thakan ka anubhav hota hai.

original_english: Sexual maturity means the body becomes capable of reproduction, but emotional maturity, which takes longer, means handling feelings and making thoughtful decisions.
hinglish_roman: Sexual maturity ka matlab hai ki body reproduce karne mein capable ho jaati hai, lekin emotional maturity, jo zyada waqt leta hai, ka matlab hai feelings ko sambhalna aur sochsamajh ke faisle karna.

original_english: The process of implantation marks the beginning of pregnancy when the zygote embeds itself into the inner lining of the uterus.
hinglish_roman: Implantation ka process pregnancy ki shuruaat ko darshata hai jab zygote apne aap ko uterus ki inner lining mein embed kar leta hai.

original_english: Reproduction is a biological process by which living beings produce new individuals of their own kind.
hinglish_roman: Reproduction ek biological process hai jisme living beings apne jaise naye individuals produce karte hain.

original_english: Asexual reproduction involves only one parent and produces genetically identical individuals called clones.
hinglish_roman: Asexual reproduction mein sirf ek parent hota hai aur genetically identical individuals, yani clones, produce hote hain.

original_english: Vegetative propagation means new plants arise from the vegetative parts of a plant.
hinglish_roman: Vegetative propagation mein naye plants, plant ke vegetative parts jaise stem, leaf, ya root se ugaaye jaate hain.

original_english: Grafting involves joining a stem piece from one plant onto a rooted plant of another variety.
hinglish_roman: Grafting mein ek plant ki stem ko doosre rooted plant ke saath join kiya jaata hai taaki new variety develop ho sake.

original_english: In budding, a bud grows on the parent body of hydra and eventually separates to live independently.
hinglish_roman: Budding mein hydra ke parent body par ek bud grow karta hai aur eventually alag hokar independently live karta hai.

original_english: Spores are lightweight and float easily through air currents, waiting for moisture to germinate.
hinglish_roman: Spores bahut lightweight hote hain aur air currents mein aasaani se float karte hain, moisture milne par germinate karte hain.

original_english: The central process behind asexual reproduction is mitosis, which produces daughter cells identical to the parent.
hinglish_roman: Asexual reproduction ka central process mitosis hai jisme daughter cells parent ke jaisi identical hoti hain.

original_english: Meiosis is a special cell division that reduces the chromosome number to half, forming gametes.
hinglish_roman: Meiosis ek special cell division hai jisme chromosome number half ho jaata hai aur gametes banate hain.

original_english: Humans have 23 pairs of chromosomes, so each gamete carries 23 chromosomes.
hinglish_roman: Humans mein 23 pairs of chromosomes hote hain, isliye har gamete mein 23 chromosomes hote hain.

original_english: The stamen is the male part of a flower, consisting of a filament and an anther that produces pollen grains.
hinglish_roman: Stamen flower ka male part hota hai, jisme ek filament aur anther hota hai jo pollen grains produce karta hai.

original_english: The pistil is the female part of a flower with three subparts — stigma, style and ovary.
hinglish_roman: Pistil flower ka female part hai jiske teen subparts hote hain — stigma, style aur ovary.

original_english: Pollination is the transfer of pollen grains from the anther to the stigma of a flower.
hinglish_roman: Pollination woh process hai jisme pollen grains anther se stigma par transfer hote hain.

original_english: In self-pollination, pollen transfers to the stigma of the same flower or another flower on the same plant.
hinglish_roman: Self-pollination mein pollen usi flower ke stigma par ya usi plant ke doosre flower ke stigma par jaata hai.

original_english: Cross-pollination occurs when pollen from one plant reaches the stigma of a flower on a different plant of the same species.
hinglish_roman: Cross-pollination tab hoti hai jab ek plant ka pollen doosre plant ke flower ke stigma par pahunchta hai, lekin same species mein.

original_english: Wind-pollinated plants like wheat and maize produce light, small pollen in large numbers.
hinglish_roman: Wind-pollinated plants jaise wheat aur maize mein pollen grains light aur small hote hain aur bahut zyada quantity mein produce hote hain.

original_english: Fertilisation occurs when the male gamete fuses with the egg cell, forming a zygote.
hinglish_roman: Fertilisation tab hoti hai jab male gamete egg cell se fuse hota hai aur ek zygote banta hai.

original_english: After fertilisation, the ovary develops into a fruit and the ovules develop into seeds.
hinglish_roman: Fertilisation ke baad ovary fruit ban jaati hai aur ovules seeds mein develop ho jaate hain.

original_english: External fertilisation in frogs occurs outside the body, where the female releases eggs in water and the male releases sperm over them.
hinglish_roman: Frogs mein external fertilisation body ke bahar hoti hai — female eggs paani mein release karti hai aur male uske upar sperm release karta hai.

original_english: Sperm are produced in the testes, which are kept slightly cooler than normal body temperature in the scrotum.
hinglish_roman: Sperm testes mein produce hote hain aur scrotum inhe normal body temperature se thoda thanda rakhta hai.

original_english: The vas deferens carries sperm from the testes to the urethra, a common passage for urine and sperm.
hinglish_roman: Vas deferens sperm ko testes se urethra tak le jaata hai, jo urine aur sperm dono ke liye common passage hai.

original_english: The female reproductive system includes a pair of ovaries, fallopian tubes, uterus and vagina.
hinglish_roman: Female reproductive system mein ek pair of ovaries, fallopian tubes, uterus aur vagina hoti hain.

original_english: Ovulation usually occurs around the 14th day of the menstrual cycle, when a mature egg is released from the ovary.
hinglish_roman: Ovulation generally menstrual cycle ke 14th day ke aaspaas hoti hai jab ovary se ek mature egg release hota hai.

original_english: If fertilisation does not occur, the uterine lining sheds — this process is called menstruation.
hinglish_roman: Agar fertilisation nahi hoti toh uterine lining shed ho jaati hai — is process ko menstruation kehte hain.

original_english: Human pregnancy lasts about nine months and is divided into three stages called trimesters.
hinglish_roman: Human pregnancy lagbhag nine months ki hoti hai aur ise teen stages mein divide kiya jaata hai jise trimesters kehte hain.

original_english: From the 9th week, the developing embryo is referred to as a foetus.
hinglish_roman: 9th week se developing embryo ko foetus kaha jaata hai.

original_english: STIs like gonorrhoea, herpes, syphilis and HIV can be transmitted during sexual contact.
hinglish_roman: STIs jaise gonorrhoea, herpes, syphilis aur HIV sexual contact ke dauran transmit ho sakte hain.

original_english: Condoms act as a barrier method of contraception and also help prevent STIs.
hinglish_roman: Condoms ek barrier method of contraception hain jo unwanted pregnancy ke saath-saath STIs ko bhi prevent karte hain.

original_english: Variation created by sexual reproduction helps species adapt to changing environments over generations.
hinglish_roman: Sexual reproduction se jo variation create hoti hai woh species ko changing environments mein adapt karne mein help karti hai.

original_english: Tissue culture technique uses shoot tip cells to mass-produce healthy plantlets, eliminating virus-infected plants.
hinglish_roman: Tissue culture technique mein shoot tip cells use karke healthy plantlets mass-produce ki jaati hain aur virus-infected plants eliminate ho jaate hain.

original_english: Sex chromosomes determine a baby's sex: females are XX and males are XY.
hinglish_roman: Sex chromosomes baby ka sex determine karte hain — females XX hoti hain aur males XY hote hain.

original_english: Every organism has a definite life span — it is born, grows, reproduces and eventually dies.
hinglish_roman: Har organism ki ek definite life span hoti hai. It is born, grows, reproduces and eventually dies.

original_english: Bryophyllum leaves can sprout tiny plantlets which grow into new plants.
hinglish_roman: Bryophyllum ki leaves pe tiny plantlets ug aate hain. These plantlets eventually grow into new, independent plants.

original_english: Fungi reproduce through spore formation; spores are produced in millions from one mould colony.
hinglish_roman: Fungi spore formation ke through reproduce karte hain. Ek mould colony se lakho spores produce hote hain.

original_english: Meiosis reduces chromosome number to half. This ensures the zygote has the correct number of chromosomes when gametes fuse.
hinglish_roman: Meiosis chromosome number ko half kar deta hai. Isliye jab gametes fuse hote hain toh zygote mein correct number of chromosomes hote hain.

original_english: Flowers attract pollinators like bees and butterflies with colour, nectar and fragrance.
hinglish_roman: Flowers apni colour, nectar aur fragrance se bees aur butterflies jaise pollinators ko attract karti hain. Yeh pollination ke liye bahut zaroori hai.

original_english: A pollen tube grows through the style to the ovary, carrying the male gamete to the egg cell.
hinglish_roman: Pollen tube style ke through ovary tak grow karta hai. It carries the male gamete directly to the egg cell.

original_english: In internal fertilisation, the fertilised egg is better protected inside the mother's body.
hinglish_roman: Internal fertilisation mein fertilised egg mother ke body ke andar protected rehta hai. Isliye young ones ke survive karne ke chances zyada hote hain.

original_english: Sperm have a head containing genetic material and a long tail that helps them swim towards the egg.
hinglish_roman: Sperm ke head mein genetic material hota hai. Aur iska long tail use egg tak pahunchne mein help karta hai.

original_english: The menstrual cycle repeats every 21–35 days and begins at puberty, continuing until menopause around age 50.
hinglish_roman: Menstrual cycle har 21 se 35 din mein repeat hoti hai. Yeh puberty par shuru hoti hai aur menopause, yani lagbhag 50 saal ki umra tak chalti hai.

original_english: After implantation, the inner lining of the uterus becomes thicker and richer in blood vessels to nourish the embryo.
hinglish_roman: Implantation ke baad uterus ki inner lining mota aur blood vessels se rich ho jaati hai. Yeh embryo ko nourish karti hai.

original_english: IUDs like Copper-T are placed in the uterus to prevent pregnancy.
hinglish_roman: Copper-T jaise IUDs uterus mein place kiye jaate hain. Yeh pregnancy ko prevent karne mein effective hote hain.

original_english: Surgical contraception blocks the vas deferens in males or the fallopian tubes in females.
hinglish_roman: Surgical contraception mein males mein vas deferens aur females mein fallopian tubes ko block kar diya jaata hai. Isse sperm aur egg kabhi nahi mil paate.

original_english: India's first test tube baby was Kanupriya Agarwal, pioneered by Subhash Mukhopadhyay in 1978.
hinglish_roman: India ki pehli test tube baby Kanupriya Agarwal thi. Subhash Mukhopadhyay ne 1978 mein yeh pioneering IVF work kiya tha.

original_english: Sexual maturity does not mean emotional maturity — emotional maturity takes longer to develop.
hinglish_roman: Sexual maturity aana matlab yeh nahi ki emotional maturity bhi aa gayi. Emotional maturity develop hone mein zyada time lagta hai.

original_english: Breastfeeding provides complete nutrition to newborns and protects them from many diseases.
hinglish_roman: Breastfeeding se newborns ko complete nutrition milti hai. Yeh unhe kai diseases se bhi protect karta hai.

original_english: Gametogenesis is the process of gamete formation that takes place in the testes and ovaries.
hinglish_roman: Gametogenesis gametes banane ki process hai. Yeh process testes aur ovaries mein hoti hai.

original_english: Wind-pollinated plants produce pollen in vast numbers; only a few reach the stigma successfully.
hinglish_roman: Wind-pollinated plants bahut zyada pollen produce karte hain. Lekin unme se sirf kuch hi stigma tak pahunch paate hain.

original_english: In artificial hybridisation, stamens are removed and pollen with desired traits is manually transferred.
hinglish_roman: Artificial hybridisation mein pehle stamens remove kiye jaate hain. Phir desired traits wale pollen ko manually transfer kiya jaata hai.

original_english: Variation among individuals, built up over generations, contributes to evolution and survival of species.
hinglish_roman: Individuals mein variation hoti hai. Yeh variation generations mein accumulate hoti hai aur species ki evolution aur survival mein contribute karti hai.

original_english: Prenatal sex determination is strictly prohibited by law in India to prevent sex-selective abortions.
hinglish_roman: Prenatal sex determination India mein strictly prohibited hai. Yeh law sex-selective abortions ko rokne ke liye banaya gaya hai.

hinglish_roman: Sir, asexual aur sexual reproduction mein kya difference hai?

hinglish_roman: Flowering plants mein fertilisation ke baad seed kaise banta hai?

hinglish_roman: Agar egg fertilise nahi hota toh menstrual cycle mein kya hota hai?

hinglish_roman: Scrotum body ke bahar kyun hota hai aur iski kya zaroorat hai?

hinglish_roman: External aur internal fertilisation mein kya fark hai? Dono ke examples bhi do.

hinglish_roman: Sexual reproduction se jo variation aati hai woh species ko survive karne mein kaise help karti hai?

hinglish_roman: IVF kya hota hai aur yeh kaise kaam karta hai?

hinglish_roman: Contraception use karna kyun zaroori hai aur iske kaunse methods hain?

hinglish_roman: Traditional vegetative propagation ke comparison mein tissue culture ka kya advantage hai?

hinglish_roman: Reproduction ke terms mein spores aur seeds mein kya fark hota hai?

hinglish_roman: Puberty mein kaunse physical aur emotional changes aate hain?

original_english: Why is prenatal sex determination prohibited by law in India?
hinglish_roman: India mein prenatal sex determination legally banned kyun hai?

original_english: What is gametogenesis and where does it occur?
hinglish_roman: Gametogenesis kya hai aur yeh body mein kahan hoti hai?

original_english: How does insect pollination differ from wind pollination in terms of pollen and flower features?
hinglish_roman: Insect pollination aur wind pollination mein pollen aur flower ke features ke basis par kya difference hota hai?

original_english: What is the role of the mother's health during pregnancy?
hinglish_roman: Pregnancy ke time mother ki health ka kya role hota hai?

hinglish_roman: Zygote, embryo aur foetus mein kya fark hota hai — yeh stages alag alag kab hote hain?

original_english: Why do wind-pollinated flowers produce so many pollen grains compared to insect-pollinated ones?
hinglish_roman: Wind-pollinated flowers itne zyada pollen grains kyun produce karte hain insect-pollinated flowers ki tulna mein?

original_english: What is post-partum depression and how should it be addressed?
hinglish_roman: Post-partum depression kya hota hai aur isko kaise address karna chahiye?

original_english: What is the role of ASHA workers in reproductive health in India?
hinglish_roman: India mein ASHA workers reproductive health mein kya role play karti hain?

hinglish_roman: Hydra mein budding ka kya biological advantage hai seeds produce karne ke comparison mein?

original_english: How does layering differ from grafting as a method of vegetative propagation?
hinglish_roman: Vegetative propagation mein layering aur grafting mein kya fark hai?

original_english: Pollination is the transfer of pollen from the anther to the stigma.
hinglish_roman: Pollination anther se pollen ka stigma mein transfer hone ka process hain.
hinglish_with_error: Pollination anther se pollen ka stigma mein transfer hone ka process hain.
error_explanation: 'Process' is singular so the verb should be 'hai' not 'hain'. 'Hain' is used for plural subjects.

original_english: The ovary of a flower develops into a fruit after fertilisation.
hinglish_roman: Fertilisation ke baad phool ki ovary fruit mein badal hoti hai.
hinglish_with_error: Fertilisation ke baad phool ki ovary fruit mein badal hoti hai.
error_explanation: The phrase 'badal hoti hai' is grammatically incomplete; the correct form is 'badal jaati hai' which indicates a change/transformation using the completive auxiliary 'jaana'.

original_english: Sperm are produced in the testes and travel through the vas deferens.
hinglish_roman: Sperm testes mein banta hain aur vas deferens se travel karta hain.
hinglish_with_error: Sperm testes mein banta hain aur vas deferens se travel karta hain.
error_explanation: 'Sperm' here is treated as plural (millions of sperm), so the verbs must be in plural form: 'bante hain' and 'karte hain', not the singular 'banta hain' and 'karta hain'.

original_english: Meiosis reduces the chromosome number to half so that gametes have 23 chromosomes.
hinglish_roman: Meiosis chromosome number ko aadha kar deta hai isliye gametes mein 23 chromosomes ka hota hai.
hinglish_with_error: Meiosis chromosome number ko aadha kar deta hai isliye gametes mein 23 chromosomes ka hota hai.
error_type: incorrect postposition + wrong plural verb form
error_explanation: The postposition 'ka' is incorrectly used with 'chromosomes'. The correct construction is simply 'chromosomes hote hain' (chromosomes are present), without 'ka'.

original_english: Vegetatively propagated plants are genetically identical because they come from a single parent.
hinglish_roman: Vegetatively propagate hue plants genetically identical hote hain kyunki woh ek hi parent ka se aate hain.
hinglish_with_error: Vegetatively propagate hue plants genetically identical hote hain kyunki woh ek hi parent ka se aate hain.
error_explanation: 'Ka se' is redundant; either 'ka' (of/belonging to) or 'se' (from) should be used, not both. The correct form is 'ek hi parent se aate hain' meaning 'come from a single parent'.

hinglish_roman: Asexual aur sexual reproduction mein kya difference hota hai?

hinglish_roman: Meiosis exactly kya hoti hai aur sexual reproduction ke liye yeh kyun zaroori hai?

hinglish_roman: Plants ko pollinators ki zaroorat kyun hoti hai aur agar pollinators khatam ho jaayein toh kya hoga?

hinglish_roman: Meiosis ke dauran kitne chromosome combinations possible hote hain, iska formula ya rule kya hai?

hinglish_roman: Kisi simple organism mein budding ka ek example de sakte ho?

hinglish_roman: Ovulation kya hoti hai aur yeh menstrual cycle ke kis din hoti hai usually?

hinglish_roman: Vegetative propagation ke methods mein grafting aur layering mein kya farq hai?

hinglish_roman: Zygote ki definition kya hai aur yeh kaise banta hai?

hinglish_roman: Kya tum example ke saath explain kar sakte ho ki sexual reproduction mein asexual reproduction se zyada variation kyun hoti hai?
